tools.name: find_agent_apis
tools.description: Search paid CSV, JSON, OpenAPI/API-discovery, HTTP, security, calendar, document, invoice, text, and U.S. weather APIs by task. Returns up to five best-matching route URLs, seller prices, categories, and free examples; does not initiate payment.

tools.name: get_agent_api_details
